angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 564,908 km at 124.37 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.0404 +/- 0.0272 mas (same row, RUWE 1.38): 124.37 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.812 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1694 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract): 564,908 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.828 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1694 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5005 +/- 65 K from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1694 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1694 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1694.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.537, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1694 (pscomppars): spectral type K2 V - K3 V, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1694 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.04 dex, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1694 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.41908, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1694 (pscomppars): age 7.8 Gyr, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1694 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.2 km/s, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
